contracts: Read-only preparation identifies the exact provider account and credit before private journal synchronization can authorize consume.
Canonical provider-account journals and locks are shared across transport hosts and plan aliases; unknown outcomes only reconcile and never replay.
Email and provider account/organization ID remain bound through consume/reconcile. Workspace-owned credential locations are authoritative; missing/invalid credentials never fall back.
New journal creation is serialized; expired settled journals can be reclaimed, while pending, corrupt and unsupported state remains preserved.
One-shot Qt queue captures use explicit release/acquire publication; filesystem synchronization and credential reads stay off the GUI thread.
Manual and automatic selections share per-account exclusion. Automatic submissions share a five-minute admission interval.
